title: Integration prior-art extract record
description: ONE admitted service, deep-read. The shape is designed in the coordinator spec's Artifact schemas section; THIS is the contract. Written as two files sharing one stem: this record and a companion `.md` carrying the three fixed body sections. A relevance bail still WRITES the record, in the `skipped` form.

item_id.description: The canonical id this record is for; the filename derives from it.

as_of.description: When the FACTS were true, not when the file was written.

found_by_angle.description: Which angles surfaced this service, COMMA-JOINED into one string — the angle-granularity corroboration signal. It is a list carried as a string because every spawn param must be a string; a scalar would make the count it feeds unreadable.

skip.description: Present iff `outcome: skipped`. A bail still writes the file.

cause.description: Typed cause; prose alone is not a cause.

detail.description: The producer's own words, saying what was checked.

id.description: The canonical id: the registrable host, lowercased. Independently resolvable, which no minted id is.

id_class.description: Verbatim from the spawn param; a class disagreeing with its id is refused.

name.description: The vendor's own name for the service.

anyOf.description: The API documentation entry point, or null.

category.description: FROZEN-BUT-EXTENSIBLE, and deliberately NOT dressed up as a standard: there is no ISO/W3C/IANA taxonomy at this granularity. Seeded from TWO named sources — the five keys the discovery convention itself names (classification-schema.md:45) unioned with the measured Nango taxonomy (981 providers, 31 categories, 2026-08-22). Where the two disagree on spelling (`payments` vs `payment`) the UPSTREAM form wins, because the join with the capability map is what this field is for. Provenance: a documented convention plus an observed vendor taxonomy, not a standard.

api_style.description: `unknown` is REQUIRED as a member: wave 1's search output carries the same field, and a candidate from a catalog cell has not had its docs read. `none` asserts a finding an a1-class angle structurally cannot establish.

integration_pattern.description: The UPSTREAM's snake_case spelling verbatim (classification-schema.md:45), so the value is directly comparable to what the discovery pass wrote into `integrations.patterns`. The two added members make this a strict SUPERSET, so every value the discovery pass can emit is representable. A silent spelling drift between two artifacts that must join is a known defect.

descriptor.description: Machine-readable descriptor kind. `unknown` for the same reason as `api_style`.

anyOf.description: Where the descriptor is served, or null.
The scheme has no OAS 3.1 type -- a token carried in the URL path is one -- per references/absent-input-policy.md section 3. Required, so the null is always a recorded decision, never an omission.
OAS 3.1 `oauth-flows` keys, VERBATIM. NOTE: there is NO IANA OAuth grant-types registry — that path 404s — so OAS 3.1's four flow keys are the bounded vocabulary here.
IANA HTTP Authentication Scheme Registry value, or null.

rate_limit_documented.description: THREE states, never a boolean. `undocumented` asserts the vendor documents no limit; `unchecked` says nobody looked. A boolean collapses those, and wave 1 can only ever produce the second.

anyOf.description: Whether a sandbox/test mode is offered.

sdk_licenses.description: SPDX ids of the SDKs above.

anyOf.description: As the registry reports it — never a derived rate.
Which registry the count came from.
The endpoint's OWN window, not a derived rate.
Dependent-repo count where a source exposes one.
Date the pricing was read; a price without its date is unplaceable.

compliance_gates.description: EMPTY LIST when b3 did not run — never null. An empty list says the angle ran and found none; null would be indistinguishable from not looking.

source_authority.description: The band of the source this record was read from, in THIS type's four bands -- the same ladder the search output and the registry use. Lens 3's denominator counts the `first-party` records, so a record read from a connector catalog must have a band of its own to carry.

items.description: A capability-map tag this service serves.

capability_tags.description: The join back to the scope.

items.description: An observation the fields cannot carry.

notes.description: Corroboration and caveats, each dated where it is a point-in-time fact.
